card.name: Partway through medical terms
card.fires_on: The last piece of a split medical term, such as the 'in' of 'Deep Vein', the digit ending a CYP enzyme name, or the 'an' of valsartan, where the next word is predictable.

modes.label: Vein in DVT
modes.description: The 'in' that completes 'Vein' in 'Deep Vein Thrombosis'.
modes.example: Treatment of Deep Ve<<in>> Thrombosis and Pulmonary Emb

modes.label: CYP enzyme digit
modes.description: The final digit of a CYP enzyme name before 'inhibitors'.
modes.example: DRUG INTERACTIONS CYP2D<<6>> Inhibitors Codeine is metabolized

modes.label: Other name endings
modes.description: The end of a drug or trial name or a nearby linking word.
modes.example: In the Valsart<<an>> in Acute Myocardial Infar

card.writes: The promoted tokens are code-like openings such as '(Max' and '(Size', so the effect on medical text is unclear.
card.plain: It fires on the final piece of a half-written medical term, mostly 'Vein' in deep vein thrombosis and CYP enzyme numbers.
